Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 82 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya directs the Pipliwan soldiers to a safe place until they face Dhananand's soldiers while Chandragupta worries about Chanakya and the soldiers. Dhananand gifts Chandragupta with weapons. Dhananand's soldier inform about Pipliwan's soldier's plan. To help the Pipliwan soldiers, Chandragupta manages to clutter big rocks in a place so as to kill Dhananand's soldiers time. On the way, the Kshtriya’s they meet Pipliwan army chief Matshal Dev and are happy to see him alive.
